description: Compare one financial concept across several companies for the same fiscal period — peer comparison. Returns one row per ticker with the latest-restated value; tickers with no data for the period are listed separately. Fiscal year/period follow each company's OWN fiscal calendar (e.g. NVDA's fiscal 2025 ended January 2025), so peer rows can cover very different calendar months — check the Period End column.

concept.description: Concept alias, e.g. 'revenue', 'net-income', 'eps-diluted'. Call with an unknown value to list supported aliases.

name: CompareFinancialFact
title: Compare Financials Across Companies
